address: 2103 San Marco Blvd., Jacksonville, FL, 32207, USA
bio: Located at the entrance to the historic San Marco Square in Jacksonville, this charming space featuring an open kitchen offers some of the best seasonal French-style cooking from husband and wife Scott and Gabrielle Alters. This dinner-only spot, having both à la carte and tasting menus, guarantees to satisfy with beautifully presented and skillfully cooked dishes. Start with the unagi tartlets, filled with a chilled koji "potato salad," topped with sweet glazed freshwater eel. Next, try the warm, savory gougères filled with black walnut béchamel. Outstanding main courses include Mediterranean sea bass, pan seared with fried mussels, matsutake mushrooms, grapes, gnocchi and a verjus vinaigrette. Complete your meal with the pleasing spiced apple crisp with vanilla ice cream and caramel drizzle.
